text: dsh-gentle-engram（DSH 插件，适用于 DSH 客户端）：为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Engram 持久记忆。它通过 Cordis Host bundle 配置 Engram 的 MCP stdio bridge，并在会话生命周期中调用记忆工具。主要功能包括会话开始时恢复相关记忆、保存用户提示、筛选并记录工具结果、在会话结束时保存摘要，以及按会话串行处理记忆操作。适合希望跨 DSH 会话保留项目背景和工作发现的用户。使用前需要在本机安装 Engram 并确保 engram 命令可用，不需要额外 API Key。

dsh-gentle-engram adds Engram memory to DSH through a Cordis bundle and MCP stdio bridge. It restores context at session start, saves prompts and filtered tool results, and records a summary when a session ends. Engram must be installed locally as the engram command.
想让 DSH 在新会话开始时自动找回之前积累的项目记忆。
希望把发给 DSH 的提示保存起来，方便后续会话延续工作。
想把 DSH 工具执行中有用的结果记进 Engram，供以后参考。
需要在 DSH 会话结束时自动保存摘要并关闭对应记忆会话。
如何让多个记忆工具调用按会话顺序完成？
I want previous project context restored when a new DSH session starts.
How can DSH save prompts and useful tool results into persistent memory?
dsh-gentle-engram 的功能「恢复会话上下文」：会话开始时调用 Engram 启动记忆会话并读取相关上下文，再注入下一步模型输入；上下文长度受配置限制。
dsh-gentle-engram 的功能「保存用户提示」：收到新用户消息时，插件会将长度超过 10 个字符的提示写入当前 Engram 会话；插件注入的恢复上下文不会重复保存。
dsh-gentle-engram 的功能「捕获工具结果」：工具执行完成后，插件可将文本结果截断到 4000 字符并存入 Engram；Engram 自身工具结果会跳过，包含 password、token 或 secret 的结果也会跳过。
dsh-gentle-engram 的功能「结束会话并保存摘要」：agent 释放时，插件先保存结构化会话摘要，再调用 Engram 结束会话；会话内的记忆调用按队列串行执行。
想让 DSH 记住之前会话中解决的问题和下一步计划。

dsh-gentle-engram README · dsh-gentle-engram：Host Cordis plugin written in TypeScript that adds reliable [Engram](https://github.com/Gentleman-Programming/engram) lifecycle behavior to DeepSeek Harness.

This integration requires [Engram](https://github.com/Gentleman-Programming/engram) to be installed and available on your system; the bridge cannot work without it.

dsh-gentle-engram README · Design：- Uses the existing `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` row for official [Engram](https://github.com/Gentleman-Programming/engram) MCP stdio tools.
- Hooks DSH session start, inbound prompts, tool results, turn stopping, and agent disposal.
- Seeds relevant [Engram](https://github.com/Gentleman-Programming/engram) context into the next model step.
- Saves prompts and filtered passive tool learnings asynchronously.
- Serializes per-session writes and waits for pending writes at turn boundaries.
- Closes [Engram](https://github.com/Gentleman-Programming/engram) sessions and records a structured summary when an agent is disposed.
- Never accesses [Engram](https://github.com/Gentleman-Programming/engram) SQLite directly and avoids forwarding likely secrets.

dsh-gentle-engram README · Installation from npm：Requirements:

- DeepSeek Harness with the `dsh plugin` command.
- [Engram](https://github.com/Gentleman-Programming/engram) installed and available as `engram` in `PATH`.
- A configured DSH profile, such as `web`.

Install the alpha channel with:

```bash
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-gentle-engram@alpha
```

For the stable channel:

```bash
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-gentle-engram
```

dsh-gentle-engram README · Installation from npm：Restart DSH after installation. The package is a Host bundle: its `cordis.patch.yml` owns both the MCP bridge and lifecycle plugin. Do not edit shipped presets or add a second manual [Engram](https://github.com/Gentleman-Programming/engram) MCP row.

Check that [Engram](https://github.com/Gentleman-Programming/engram) is available before starting DSH:

```bash
engram --version
```

dsh-gentle-engram README · Local development：```bash
pnpm install

```
